text: Last summer, I finally travelled abroad for the first time. I spent weeks planning the trip, booking flights, and finding a cheap hotel. When I arrived, everything felt exciting but also a little scary. I loved learning about new cultures and trying local food, even when I wasn't sure what I was eating! The biggest challenge was the language barrier. Simple things like asking for directions became a funny game of gestures and smiles. Despite the difficulties, I made amazing memories that I will never forget. Now I understand why people say travel changes you.
